function.name: type_autoreg
function.description: Register ONE new type.com agent account (mail.tm dynamic domain -> auth.type.com/agent/identity -> agent-signup start/verify -> jwt-bearer exchange). Takes 60-180s. Account lands in the gateway pool.

org.description: Organization slug for signup. Default: reform-org

function.name: type_pool_refresh
function.description: Refresh identity tokens for ALL accounts in the pool (rotating refresh_token + jwt-bearer re-exchange). Call when upstream returns 401/token expired.

function.name: type_status
function.description: Manager status: gateway up/down (:8311), pool count, recent log lines.

function.name: type_accounts
function.description: List pool accounts (redacted — no tokens): email, org, token lengths, last status.

function.name: tt_files
function.description: Browse/read the type-toolkit repo from the agent. Directory listing or file content (<=2MB). Credential files (pool.json, acct.json, api_token.json) are withheld automatically.

function.name: type_chat
function.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completion via the gateway (:8311) — pool-backed rotation. NOTE: upstream api.type.com currently returns 401 on agent tokens (aud=client policy); status is proxied verbatim.
